newsitem.title: USA: Moody's changes Howard Univ. outlook to stable.
newsitem.headline: Moody's changes Howard Univ. outlook to stable.

text.p: NEW YORK, May 5 - Moody's Investors Service Inc. said Monday it confirmed an A3 rating on $155 million of Howard University's long-term debt, but revised its intermediate-term outlook on the University's debt rating to stable from negative.
The outlook change is based on a reduced threat of major federal funding cuts, improvement in some areas of health care operations, and evidence of a stabilzed sudent market position.
